answers.question: Is this an IT band thing? Should I still do Wednesday's tempo?
answers.answer:
I am not going to name it, because that is a job for a sports physio or sports doctor, not me. New sharp pain on downhills, pain on stairs the next day, and having to walk home are all reasons to get it looked at this week before you train through it.

No on Wednesday's tempo. Threshold on a sore knee is exactly how a small niggle becomes a long layoff, and we have 10 weeks to the race, so a quiet week now is cheap insurance. If the knee is fully quiet by the weekend we can look at adding a little shape back the week after.

new.analysis:
## What happened

You did four of five sessions as planned, then the long run turned on you at mile 7 with lateral right knee pain that got worse on the downhills. Stopping at 8.5 and walking home was the right call. The tempo on Wednesday was sharp and well paced, and the easy runs sat right where they should on heart rate.

## Why I am pulling back

New pain that shows up during a run, worsens on downhills, and is still there going down stairs the next day is the kind of signal I take seriously, especially when you have been injury-free for two years. We are 10 weeks out, which is enough runway to lose a week of quality and still arrive sharp, but not enough to train through something that is getting worse. See a sports physio or sports doctor this week.

## How to run next week

Only run if the knee is quiet walking stairs that morning; if it is sore, swap the run for 30 – 45 min on a bike or in the pool at an easy effort. Keep routes flat, because the downhills are what lit it up on Sunday. The long run is shorter and flat on purpose, and I would rather you cut it short again than push through sharp pain.

## Looking ahead

If the knee settles and the physio clears you to build, the week of Aug 24 can add a gentle marathon-pace segment back in and nudge the long run toward 14 mi. If it is still grumbling, we will hold easy volume and extend the conservative block another week; the race plan still works from there.
